abiEvidence.binding: Full original exact-address ABI and verified compiler-input sources retained. Service match status preserved literally; no generic fork ABI and no fresh runtime identity assertion. Source has no delegate fallback or upgrade storage; proxyResolution reports isProxy=false.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5,05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the value {ERC20} uses, unless {_setupDecimals} is called. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

params.account: The address of the account to check
params.blockNumber: The block number to get the vote balance at

returns._0: The number of votes the account had as of the given block

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. Requirements: - `sender` and `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - `sender` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``sender``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

selectedFunctions.label: Tarot Deposit native USDC
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only: no fresh runtime identity, funding, liquidity, execution success, complete workflow or financial-safety assurance. Exact-function grants, canonical calldata/value checks, pauses and independent controls still apply.

Only OP Mainnet native-USDC SupplyVaultV2 0x4ac8af23f3ef7ededb3dc45c091406aeee8de471 is admitted. Underlying is 6-decimal native USDC 0x0b2c639c533813f4aa9d7837caf62653d097ff85 and tUSDC shares also use 6 decimals. This is not Fantom legacy tUSDC, bridged USDC.e, a leveraged router, or an unrelated curator wrapper.

enter pulls positive USDC from caller with allowance to this vault and mints shares to caller. enterWithToken accepts only the fixed underlying or an owner-enabled registered Tarot borrowable, valuing the latter with its exchangeRate; it is not a caller-selected executor or arbitrary token swap. Tokens must not be taxed. Shares floor on conversion and there is no minimum-shares or deadline, including zero-share mint risk for small deposits.

leave burns caller shares and pays caller underlying after configured strategy deallocation, which can fail for insufficient cash or strategy authorization/configuration. Share value is recomputed after unwinding costs and may be lower. No share allowance/delegated owner, minimum output or deadline; positive output and sufficient cash are required. No queued claim or guaranteed withdrawal delay.

leaveInKind burns caller shares and sends proportional underlying AND every registered borrowable token, including disabled borrowables, to caller without attempting cash redemption. It is callable while paused, but that does not make retired deployments eligible. Per-token floors can produce dust/zero components; at least one payout is required. This admission does not separately admit redemption of the received borrowable tokens.

Initial constructor pauses the vault, but current explorer snapshot reports paused=false, native-USDC underlying and strategy 0x1753F90AcC5fF758Eb621F935ef0F99254289fb1; the current official app lists this exact OP vault without paused/deactivated flags. These observations are not persistent state guarantees. Underwater checkpoint accounting blocks deposits until restored even if global pause is false.

Fee accounting mints shares on gains above checkpoint to feeTo; initial feeBps=1000, owner may set 0..5000. Current explorer snapshot reported feeBps=1000 and feeTo=zero (fee mint skipped), not a permanent fee waiver. Owner controls pause, borrowable membership, fee recipient and strategy changes; strategy update requires a 2..30-day not-before window and 14-day grace. No user lockup is encoded in ordinary calls.

Ordinary entry/exit use configured strategy allocate/deallocate, not user opaque payloads. Source-bound current reported SupplyVaultStrategyV4 restricts these to authorized vaults and registered borrowables; its deallocation can revert INSUFFICIENT_CASH. Current strategy authorization and member-token behavior are unattested. Administrative reallocate(bytes), delegation/signatures, token approvals/transfers and accounting/quote maintenance stay unadmitted.

No user KYC/allowlist check appears in reviewed ordinary vault source; this does not establish jurisdictional eligibility, sanctions compliance or legal permission. All selected calls are nonpayable and require zero native value.
